hook: Run a corvid crime family: borrow to get ahead, and every loan and repayment sets off a chain of buffs.
loop: Owe Debt for stats, gold or credit buys; pay some off.
Each clear grows units and your Ledger; held Debt powers carriers.
Capstones cash in: Corbie's Ledger, Seven's exactly 7, Rookery Don's Skims.

growth.line: Small permanent buffs per clear each turn; Tier 5-6 capstones scale with Debt held, Ledger or Skims.

feel.early: Optional loans for stats; Tier up waits.
feel.mid: Juggling Debt: pay it, carry it, or Skim through wins.
feel.late: Big board-wide buffs from Debt, Ledger or Skims.

stars.why: Exactly 7 Debt turns every Owe and Pay into aiming.
Tier up on credit: rush now, owe big, hope you win.
Sell units to clear Debt; turns other tribes into payments.

card_short.u01: When played: may Owe for permanent stats.
card_short.u02: Grows permanently when you clear Debt, once a turn.
card_short.u03: Once a turn, buy a unit on credit.
card_short.u04: Clearing Debt buffs a random friendly unit, twice a turn.
card_short.u05: Gold each Start of Turn while you have Debt.
card_short.u06: End of Turn: Owe 1, buff units next to this.
card_short.u07: Owe each End of Turn; gold back, more after wins.
card_short.u08: Skim 2; extra Attack in fights per Debt held.
card_short.u09: Selling a unit clears Debt equal to its tier.
card_short.u10: End of Turn: board buff per 3 Debt cleared.
card_short.u11: Tier up on credit, even while you owe.
card_short.u12: Each Owe gives your other units Attack, twice a turn.
card_short.u13: Skim 2; Skim with nothing to clear becomes gold.
card_short.u14: Every Debt cleared counts double for Ledger and counters.
card_short.u15: Start of Combat: buffs your board per 3 Debt held.
card_short.u16: After a win, copy the enemy's biggest unit; Owe 4.
card_short.u17: Start of Combat: buffs your board by your Ledger.
card_short.u18: Start of Combat: exactly 7 Debt gives others +7/+7.
card_short.u19: Skim 3; every Skimmed Debt permanently buffs your board.

builds.name: The Long Ledger
builds.line: Owe each End of Turn, pay it off, grow on every clear.

builds.name: On Tick
builds.line: Hold Debt into fights for Attack, gold and Seven's exactly 7.

builds.name: Protection Racket
builds.line: Win early so Skim clears Debt free; Rookery Don cashes in.

liked: Seven's exactly-7 Debt puzzle: every reviewer's standout, and the best puzzle in the set.
One IOU pile read three ways (carry, clear, Skim) feels like nothing else.
worries: Uncle Jack may be every lobby's auto-pick; Arne gets huge at 30 Debt.
Rookery Don plus Sorrow and Joy runs hot; many Debt rules feel like bookkeeping.
changed: Debt rules made plannable: card Debt waits a turn, interest payable at once.
Losing a fight with Debt now costs extra hero damage.
Uncle Jack no longer lifts the tier lock; Memory now gives full stats.
verdict: Rated 6.7 fun and 8 distinct, third of its seed's three; for players who love sequencing puzzles and tempo gambles.
